name: CEO Agent
description: AI chief of staff that keeps you informed across every channel. Syncs conversations from Telegram, Slack, and meeting tools into weekly intelligence reports. Pushes action items to your project manager and CRM. Summarizes any content — video, audio, PDFs, web pages. Connects 20+ apps. Has persistent knowledge brain (gbrain) for cross-session memory.
headline: Your AI chief of staff — weekly reports, knowledge brain, and 20+ app connections
author: Clawdi
suggested_prompts: What meetings do I have this week?
Sync my Slack and Gmail conversations
What did we decide about pricing last week?
